changelog.en:
New: dynamic night stars on the Grass Vulkan renderer — sky gradient now uses the same program data as the GL version (no more static stars baked into the texture), with twinkling stars across 4 tints and a configurable count up to 10000
New: split the Grass legacy particle toggle into separate legacy dandelion / legacy firefly switches (legacy takes priority per type), removing the mutually-locked switches
New: swipe ripple toggle on the Fall wallpaper (continuous ripples while swiping, 13 languages)
New: grass night backdrop toggle on the Fireworks wallpaper
New: wallpaper settings gated behind parent toggles — Grass (weather system and procedural sun disabled under the Vulkan backend), Galaxy spiral sliders, NixieTube audio, PhaseBeam recolor, vis2/3/6 recolor mode
New: preview frame rate now follows the global frame rate setting

Fixed: grass blades freezing above 60 FPS
Fixed: Grass Vulkan draw order — sun/moon no longer draw over the grass blades, moon no longer covers fireflies
Fixed: soft-disabled preferences now gray out correctly in real time (dynamic section rebuild when a dependency toggle changes), and no longer crash when a disabled SeekBar renders on ANGLE-based devices
Fixed: distant windmill blades misaligned with the pole
Fixed: raindrop animation speed aligned with the original version
Fixed: procedural sun core too dark on the GL Grass wallpaper
Fixed: background color labels on vis4/vis5 showing raw layout keys (13 languages)

Changed: removed 4 unused sky images from Grass (APK ~2.8 MB smaller)
changelog.zh:
新增：草地壁纸 Vulkan 版动态星星——天空渐变改用与 GL 版相同的程序数据（不再有贴图中的静态星星），4 种色调闪烁星星，数量可配（最高 10000）
新增：草地壁纸传统粒子开关按类型拆分（传统蒲公英 / 传统萤火虫，传统优先），消除互斥锁死的开关
新增：落叶壁纸滑动水波纹开关（滑动产生连续水波纹，13 种语言）
新增：烟花壁纸草地夜景背景开关
新增：壁纸设置按父开关门控——草地（Vulkan 后端下禁用天气系统与程序化太阳）、银河螺旋参数、辉光管音频、相位光束颜色、vis2/3/6 着色模式
新增：预览帧率跟随全局帧率设置

修复：草地壁纸 60 FPS 以上草叶冻结
修复：草地壁纸 Vulkan 版绘制层级（太阳/月亮不再盖在草叶上、月亮不再遮挡萤火虫）
修复：软禁用设置项实时正确置灰（依赖开关变化时动态重建列表），并修复 ANGLE 设备上禁用 SeekBar 渲染导致的崩溃
修复：风车远距叶片与杆错位
修复：雨滴动画速度对齐原版
修复：GL 版程序化太阳中心亮度不足
修复：vis4/vis5 背景颜色标签显示原始 key（13 种语言）

变更：删除草地壁纸 4 张未使用天空贴图（APK 减小约 2.8MB）
